description: What one trade may lose, and whether an entry over it is refused.

amount.description: The fixed amount one trade may lose, as a decimal string.

capital.description:
Declare the capital for `currency`. Both or neither: a capital with
no currency has nothing to be keyed by, and nothing here converts
between currencies.

lock.description:
Whether an entry over the risk per trade is refused. Left out, the
lock stays as it is.

percent.description: The share of declared capital one trade may lose.

title: SetRiskInput
